title: Models and Algorithms for Reserve Deliverability in Cross-Zonal Balancing Capacity Markets
summary: In power markets where the physics of the transmission grid is closely represented in market clearing models, certain cross-zonal power exchanges can take place only if other exchanges occur concurrently. This leads to challenges in cross-zonal balancing capacity markets, where the activation of reserves in real time remains uncertain. Ensuring reserve deliverability in all activation scenarios is naturally modeled as a stochastic programming (SP) problem, whose size grows exponentially with the number of locations in the network.
